_comment: TODO(IT-AUTH): provisional employee directory ONLY. Replace with a lookup against GMF IT's real employee/user table once its name and schema are confirmed (see SRS.md section 3.7 Open Question). Keys are opaque demo user_id values resolved server-side from the X-User-Id header — never trust a client-supplied dinas/role value directly. Extend this file (or move it into rdt.dinas_mapping-style DB table) as more demo identities are needed; do not hardcode new users in code. Every dinas gets a PIC login (all 21 dinas file transaction reports, confirmed with project owner). Dinas 'TA' was retired and merged into 'TAB' — same entity (confirmed with project owner). Role 'ADMIN_TAB' was renamed to plain 'TAB' (24 Jul correction, project owner) — same role/permissions, just dropped the 'ADMIN' prefix. Roles SM_TA/GH_TA were REMOVED entirely (24 Jul, project owner correction): RDT is small enough that role TAB alone handles Repost/Confirmation/Need Approval — TAB approves every submission once 100% confirmed (including Corp's), and sees every dinas pair's Dashboard-Detailing + comment thread, not just its own. There is deliberately NO 'demo-pic-corp' login: no such person exists — dinas 'Corp' is a real value transactions can target (from the Excel data), but it has no dedicated confirming PIC; ONLY TAB role confirms it (REQ-RDT-AUTH-04), and the label stays 'Corp' on the data.
